Project a layer onto the walls of the panel box

Source: R/positions-project.R
position_project_3d.Rd

Draws a layer flattened onto panes of the panel box: shadows of points on the floor, contours on a side wall, or a whole two-dimensional ggplot2 layer such as a histogram or density drawn as a marginal on a wall.

Usage

position_project_3d(onto = "floor", axes = NULL)

Arguments

onto

Where the layer is drawn. "floor" is the low face of the vertical axis; "back" the rear one of each pair of vertical faces, chosen for the camera as for the panes drawn by coord_3d(); a pane name of the panel frame ("xmin", "xmax", "ymin", "ymax", "zmin", "zmax" for the box, or a pane of a curvilinear frame); or list(axis = "y", at = 0) for the plane where that axis takes a value in data units. A character vector, or a list mixing names and planes, draws the layer once per target.

axes

NULL for a three-dimensional layer. For a two-dimensional ggplot2 layer, the two 3D axes that receive its x and y, such as c("x", "z") to stand a histogram of x on a y wall. The layer is then drawn on the targets perpendicular to the remaining axis, and its x and y train the scales of those axes.

Value

A ggplot2 position adjustment.

Details

The replaced coordinate does not train the scales: a projected layer is drawn on the expanded panel box of the other layers. Primitives on a pane are painted with that pane: behind every data layer on a rear pane, over them on a pane facing the camera, so a shadow is never hidden by the pane it lies on. Planes at a data value are depth-sorted with the data. Surface normals of a flattened layer point into the box.

The approach follows position_on_face() in ggcube, contour projections in matplotlib (zdir, offset) and plot3D (contour = list(side = )).

See also

geom_rug_3d() for marginal ticks on the walls.

Examples

d <- data.frame(x = rnorm(60), y = rnorm(60), z = rnorm(60))
p <- ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(x, y, z = z))
p + geom_point_3d(colour = "grey40", position = position_project_3d(c("floor", "back"))) +
  geom_point_3d(colour = "steelblue") + coord_3d()

g <- expand.grid(x = seq(-2, 2, length.out = 25), y = seq(-2, 2, length.out = 25))
g$z <- exp(-g$x^2 - g$y^2)
ggplot2::ggplot(g, ggplot2::aes(x, y, z = z)) +
  geom_surface_3d(fill = "grey85", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_contour_3d(bins = 5, colour = "navy", position = position_project_3d("floor")) +
  geom_contour_filled_3d(bins = 5, position = position_project_3d("back")) +
  coord_3d()

p + geom_point_3d() +
  ggplot2::geom_density(ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = ggplot2::after_stat(scaled) * 2),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "grey60", alpha = 0.6,
    position = position_project_3d("back", axes = c("x", "z"))) +
  coord_3d()
